description: Up to 60 transit events in a window of up to 92 days, the most significant kept when there are more: exact transit-to-natal aspects by date, sign ingresses and stations. (Premium or MAX) Use it for forecasts over weeks or months (a year is four windows); for a single day use daily_transits.

time.description: Local birth time, HH:mm, 24-hour. null when unknown: the chart is computed for noon and everything that depends on the time is withheld.

timezone.description: IANA time zone. Leave it out to resolve it from the coordinates; historical daylight-saving rules are applied to the date.

to.description: At most 92 days after from; 30 days by default.

name: transits
title: Transits for a period
